rawContent: Because he was Black, paramedics gave a diabetic man a potentially fatal dose of Ketamine and Versed, the drugs that killed #ElijahMcClain, instead of the sugar he needed to save his life. It’s not just the cops who aren’t safe for Black folks to call for help. #BlackLivesMatter
The cubby letters behind ⁦@ewarren⁩ are BLM #BlackLivesMatter. That is no accident. I love her so much. My heart is so full. #DNC2020 https://t.co/NkEA1MLSfH

#Kenosha sits amid a solid cluster of #SundownTowns surrounding where I grew up in SE WI, and its racist history fuels its racist present. There’s no defending Kenosha PD for its shooting of #JacobBlake, and the cops must be arrested and charged. #BlackLivesMatter

Gods above and below, it is exhausting arguing the humanity and rights of Black people to live with people who will just not concede either point, let alone their right to protest that fact. #BlackLivesMatter
